title: Ὁ Φίλος καὶ Οἱ Γεωργοί
subtitle: Unit 2, Chapter 4 — The Friend and the Farmers

panels.scene: Wide landscape at dawn. The eastern horizon glows with the first golden light of sunrise. The last trace of the moon is pale and fading in the brightening sky. The field and house are visible below.
panels.greekCaption: πρωΐ ἐστιν. ἡ σελήνη οὐκέτι λάμπει. ὁ ἥλιος ἀνατέλλει.
panels.englishCaption: It is morning. The moon no longer shines. The sun rises.

captionTranslations.es: Es de mañana. La luna ya no brilla. El sol sale.
captionTranslations.pl: Jest ranek. Księżyc już nie świeci. Słońce wschodzi.
captionTranslations.fil: Umaga na. Hindi na sumisinag ang buwan. Sumisinag ang araw.

panels.scene: Interior of the house. A beam of morning light enters through the open door, falling across the room and onto the bed where the farmer lies.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ φῶς τοῦ ἡλίου ἔρχεται εἰς τὸν οἶκον.
panels.englishCaption: The light of the sun comes into the house.

captionTranslations.es: La luz del sol viene a la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Światło słońca wchodzi do domu.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang liwanag ng araw ay pumapasok sa bahay.

panels.scene: The farmer sits up in bed, calm and rested, a hand on his chest. Morning light on his face. No fear — only peace.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς ἐγείρεται. οὐκ ἔχει φόβον. εἰρήνη ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer wakes. He has no fear. There is peace in his heart.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor se despierta. No tiene miedo. Hay paz en su corazón.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik budzi się. Nie ma strachu. W jego sercu jest pokój.
captionTranslations.fil: Gumising ang magsasaka. Wala siyang takot. May kapayapaan sa kanyang puso.

panels.scene: The farmer walks toward the river in the early light, carrying a cloth, moving purposefully toward the water.
panels.greekCaption: θέλει λούειν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ. πορεύεται πρὸς τὸν ποταμόν.
panels.englishCaption: He wants to wash his body. He goes toward the river.

captionTranslations.es: Quiere lavar su cuerpo. Va hacia el río.
captionTranslations.pl: Chce umyć swoje ciało. Idzie do rzeki.
captionTranslations.fil: Gusto niyang hugasan ang kanyang katawan. Pumunta siya sa ilog.

panels.scene: Close-up: the farmer crouched at the river's edge, cupping clear water in his hands. The water looks clean and inviting.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ ποταμοῦ καλόν ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The water of the river is good.

captionTranslations.es: El agua del río es buena.
captionTranslations.pl: Woda rzeki jest dobra.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang tubig ng ilog ay mabuti.

panels.scene: The farmer, refreshed, walks back along the path from the river toward the house. Wet hair, clean face, light step.
panels.greekCaption: λούει τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ. πορεύεται πάλιν πρὸς τὸν οἶκον.
panels.englishCaption: He washes his body. He goes back toward the house.

captionTranslations.es: Lava su cuerpo. Regresa hacia la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Myje swoje ciało. Wraca do domu.
captionTranslations.fil: Niligo niya ang kanyang katawan. Bumalik siya sa bahay.

panels.scene: The farmer stands facing the viewer, full figure, with the name Ἰάκωβος displayed beside him — the reveal of his name. Clear, warm, dignified.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ γεωργοῦ ἐστιν Ἰάκωβος.
panels.englishCaption: The name of the farmer is Jacob.

captionTranslations.es: El nombre del agricultor es Jacob.
captionTranslations.pl: Imię rolnika to Jakub.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang pangalan ng magsasaka ay Jacob.

panels.scene: A wider landscape of Galilean countryside: rolling green hills, small farms, the Sea of Galilee visible in the distance. Jacob small in the foreground, surveying his land.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος Γαλιλαῖός ἐστιν. κατοικεῖ ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob is a Galilean. He dwells in Galilee.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob es galileo. Vive en Galilea.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub jest Galilejczykiem. Mieszka w Galilei.
captionTranslations.fil: Si Jacob ay isang Galileo. Naninirahan siya sa Galilea.

panels.scene: Jacob standing at the edge of the field but turned away from it, looking toward the path. His tools are set down. He has decided not to work today.
panels.greekCaption: σήμερον οὐκ ἐργάζεται ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ.
panels.englishCaption: Today he does not work in the field.

captionTranslations.es: Hoy no trabaja en el campo.
captionTranslations.pl: Dziś nie pracuje w polu.
captionTranslations.fil: Ngayon hindi siya nagtatrabaho sa bukid.

panels.scene: A small Galilean village in the distance — clustered stone houses, a few trees, a dusty path leading to it. Jacob on the path, walking toward it.
panels.greekCaption: πορεύεται πρὸς τὴν κώμην.
panels.englishCaption: He goes toward the village.

captionTranslations.es: Va hacia el pueblo.
captionTranslations.pl: Idzie do wioski.
captionTranslations.fil: Pumunta siya sa nayon.

panels.scene: Jacob paused on the path, looking back at the field with concern. Then turning forward toward another farm nearby. Who will guard the field?
panels.greekCaption: τίς φυλάσσει τὸν ἀγρόν; πορεύεται πρὸς τὸν φίλον αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: Who guards the field? He goes to his friend.

captionTranslations.es: ¿Quién cuida el campo? Va a su amigo.
captionTranslations.pl: Kto strzeże pola? Idzie do swojego przyjaciela.
captionTranslations.fil: Sino ang nagbabantay ng bukid? Pumunta siya sa kanyang kaibigan.

panels.scene: Philip standing outside his own house, holding a farming tool, welcoming expression. His name Φίλιππος displayed beside him. His farm is near Jacob's.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ φίλου ἐστὶν Φίλιππος. πλησίον ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: The name of the friend is Philip. He is a neighbor.

captionTranslations.es: El nombre del amigo es Felipe. Es vecino.
captionTranslations.pl: Imię przyjaciela to Filip. Jest sąsiadem.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang pangalan ng kaibigan ay Felipe. Siya ay kapitbahay.

panels.scene: Jacob and Philip standing side by side, both in farmer's tunics, both holding tools. Equal in dignity.
panels.greekCaption: ἀμφότεροι εἰσιν γεωργοί.
panels.englishCaption: Both are farmers.

captionTranslations.es: Ambos son agricultores.
captionTranslations.pl: Obaj są rolnikami.
captionTranslations.fil: Kapwa silang magsasaka.

panels.scene: The two men in the ancient Middle-Eastern greeting: clasping hands and kissing on the cheek. Warm, genuine friendship.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἀσπάζεται τὸν Φίλιππον καὶ καταφιλεῖ αὐτόν.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob greets Philip and kisses him.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob saluda a Felipe y lo besa.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub pozdrawia Filipa i całuje go.
captionTranslations.fil: Binati ni Jacob si Felipe at hinalikan siya.

panels.scene: Jacob speaking to Philip, hand raised in greeting, mouth open mid-sentence. Philip listening and smiling.
panels.greekCaption: λέγει, "εἰρήνη σοι. πῶς ἔχεις σήμερον;"
panels.englishCaption: He says, "Peace to you. How are you today?"

captionTranslations.es: Dice: 'Paz a ti. ¿Cómo estás hoy?'
captionTranslations.pl: Mówi: «Pokój tobie. Jak się dziś masz?»
captionTranslations.fil: Sinabi niya: 'Kapayapaan sa iyo. Kumusta ka ngayon?'

panels.scene: Philip responding, one hand on his chest, smiling warmly.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Φίλιππος ἀποκρίνεται, "χαῖρε. καλῶς ἔχω."
panels.englishCaption: Philip answers, "Greetings. I am well."

captionTranslations.es: Felipe responde: 'Saludos. Estoy bien.'
captionTranslations.pl: Filip odpowiada: «Pozdrowienia. Mam się dobrze.»
captionTranslations.fil: Sumagot si Felipe: 'Kumusta. Mabuti naman ako.'

panels.scene: Philip's face showing friendly curiosity — eyebrow raised, head tilted.
panels.greekCaption: "διὰ τί ἔρχῃ ὧδε;"
panels.englishCaption: "Why do you come here?"

captionTranslations.es: '¿Por qué vienes aquí?'
captionTranslations.pl: «Dlaczego tu przychodzisz?»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Bakit ka pumunta dito?'

panels.scene: Jacob's face showing longing — looking into the distance toward the village, hand over his heart.
panels.greekCaption: "ἀγαπῶ τὸν οἶκόν μου. βούλομαι βλέπειν αὐτόν."
panels.englishCaption: "I love my house. I want to see it."

captionTranslations.es: 'Amo mi casa. Quiero verla.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Kocham mój dom. Chcę go zobaczyć.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Mahal ko ang aking bahay. Gusto kong makita ito.'

panels.scene: Philip asking about Jacob's family. A soft inset shows a woman and children — the family Jacob misses.
panels.greekCaption: "ἆρα ἡ Μάρθα ἡ γυνή σου καλῶς ἔχει; καὶ τὰ τέκνα;"
panels.englishCaption: "Does Martha your wife fare well? And the children?"

captionTranslations.es: '¿Está bien Marta tu esposa? ¿Y los hijos?'
captionTranslations.pl: «Czy Marta, twoja żona, ma się dobrze? I dzieci?»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Mabuti ba si Marta na iyong asawa? At ang mga anak?'

panels.scene: Jacob's face showing worry — furrowed brow, looking back over his shoulder toward the field.
panels.greekCaption: "ναί, πάντες καλῶς ἔχουσιν. ἀλλὰ μεριμνῶ περὶ τοῦ ἀγροῦ."
panels.englishCaption: "Yes, they are all well — but I worry about the field."

captionTranslations.es: 'Sí, todos están bien, pero me preocupo por el campo.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Tak, wszyscy mają się dobrze, ale martwię się o pole.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Oo, lahat ay mabuti — ngunit nag-aalala ako sa bukid.'

panels.scene: Philip stepping forward confidently, hand on Jacob's shoulder, reassuring expression. A stance of capability and willingness.
panels.greekCaption: "ἐγὼ πάρειμι. δύναμαι βοηθεῖν σοι."
panels.englishCaption: "I am here. I am able to help you."

captionTranslations.es: 'Estoy aquí. Puedo ayudarte.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Jestem tutaj. Mogę ci pomóc.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Nandito ako. Kaya kong tulungan ka.'

panels.scene: Philip pointing firmly toward the village road, other hand raised in a reassuring gesture. Commanding but kind.
panels.greekCaption: "μὴ μεριμνᾷ. πορεύου πρὸς τὴν κώμην."
panels.englishCaption: "Do not worry. Go to the village."

captionTranslations.es: 'No te preocupes. Ve al pueblo.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Nie martw się. Idź do wioski.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Huwag mag-alala. Pumunta sa nayon.'

panels.scene: Jacob clasping Philip's hand in both of his, looking him in the eyes. Deep gratitude.
panels.greekCaption: "ἀληθῶς φίλος ἀγαθὸς καὶ πιστὸς εἶ. ἀγαπῶ σε."
panels.englishCaption: "Truly you are a good and faithful friend. I love you."

captionTranslations.es: 'En verdad eres un amigo bueno y fiel. Te amo.'
captionTranslations.pl: «Prawdziwie jesteś dobrym i wiernym przyjacielem. Kocham cię.»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Tunay na ikaw ay isang mabuti at tapat na kaibigan. Mahal kita.'

panels.scene: Jacob turning away from Philip, hand raised in farewell, beginning to walk. Philip watching him go.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἀπέρχεται ἀπὸ τοῦ Φιλίππου.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob departs from Philip.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob parte de Felipe.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub odchodzi od Filipa.
captionTranslations.fil: Umalis si Jacob mula kay Felipe.

panels.scene: Jacob standing at the edge of his field, cupping his hand near his mouth, calling. The donkey visible in the field, head raised, ears perked.
panels.greekCaption: ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ καλεῖ τὸν ὄνον.
panels.englishCaption: In the field he calls the donkey.

captionTranslations.es: En el campo llama al asno.
captionTranslations.pl: W polu woła osła.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa bukid tinatawag niya ang asno.

panels.scene: Jacob and the donkey walking side by side on the road toward the village. Jacob's face relaxed, almost smiling. Morning light — a mood of lightness and anticipation.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἀπέρχεται μετὰ χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob departs with joy and peace.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob parte con alegría y paz.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub odchodzi z radością i pokojem.
captionTranslations.fil: Umalis si Jacob nang may kagalakan at kapayapaan.

panels.scene: A wider view from behind: Jacob and the donkey together on the dirt road, the village visible in the distance ahead, fields on either side.
panels.greekCaption: ἀμφότεροι πορεύονται ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ πρὸς τὴν κώμην.
panels.englishCaption: Both go on the road toward the village.

captionTranslations.es: Ambos van por el camino hacia el pueblo.
captionTranslations.pl: Obaj idą drogą ku wiosce.
captionTranslations.fil: Kapwa silang lumalakad sa daan patungo sa nayon.

panels.scene: Jacob on the road, staff in one hand, a leather satchel slung over his shoulder. The donkey follows behind, loaded with produce.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ Ἰάκωβος περιπατεῖ μετὰ τῆς ῥάβδου καὶ φέρει τὴν πήραν.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob walks with his staff and carries his bag.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob camina con su vara y lleva su bolsa.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub idzie z laską i niesie torbę.
captionTranslations.fil: Lumalakad si Jacob kasama ang kanyang tungkod at dinadala ang kanyang bag.

panels.scene: Close-up of the open bag showing a loaf of bread inside.
panels.greekCaption: ἐν τῇ πήρᾳ ἔχει ἄρτον.
panels.englishCaption: In the bag he has bread.

captionTranslations.es: En la bolsa tiene pan.
captionTranslations.pl: W torbie ma chleb.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa bag niya ay mayroon siyang tinapay.

panels.scene: The donkey loaded with baskets — fruit visible on one side, vegetables on the other.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ὄνος φέρει πολλοὺς καρποὺς καὶ πολλὰ λάχανα ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The donkey carries many fruits and many vegetables from the field.

captionTranslations.es: El asno lleva muchas frutas y muchas verduras del campo.
captionTranslations.pl: Osioł niesie wiele owoców i wiele warzyw z pola.
captionTranslations.fil: Dinadala ng asno ang maraming prutas at maraming gulay mula sa bukid.

panels.scene: The road becoming busier: several farmers visible walking in different directions. Other farms alongside the road.
panels.greekCaption: ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ βλέπει πολλοὺς ἄλλους γεωργούς.
panels.englishCaption: On the road he sees many other farmers.

captionTranslations.es: En el camino ve a muchos otros agricultores.
captionTranslations.pl: Na drodze widzi wielu innych rolników.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa daan nakakita siya ng maraming ibang magsasaka.

panels.scene: A crossroads: farmers moving in both directions — some heading away from the village with tools, some heading toward it with produce.
panels.greekCaption: οἱ μὲν ἔρχονται ἐκ τῆς κώμης, οἱ δὲ πορεύονται πρὸς τοὺς ἀγρούς.
panels.englishCaption: Some come from the village, some go toward their fields.

captionTranslations.es: Algunos vienen del pueblo, otros van hacia sus campos.
captionTranslations.pl: Jedni przychodzą z wioski, inni idą na pola.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba ay nagmumula sa nayon, ang iba ay pumupunta sa kanilang mga bukid.

panels.scene: A farmer on the road raises his hand in greeting as Jacob passes. Jacob greeting back. Brief and friendly.
panels.greekCaption: ἀσπάζονται τὸν Ἰάκωβον ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.
panels.englishCaption: They greet Jacob on the road.

captionTranslations.es: Saludan a Jacob en el camino.
captionTranslations.pl: Pozdrawiają Jakuba na drodze.
captionTranslations.fil: Binabati nila si Jacob sa daan.

panels.scene: Farmers working hard in a large field: two digging with mattocks, one carrying a stone.
panels.greekCaption: οἱ μὲν σκάπτουσιν τὴν γῆν καὶ φέρουσιν τοὺς λίθους ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν.
panels.englishCaption: Some dig the earth and carry stones out of the fields.

captionTranslations.es: Algunos cavan la tierra y sacan las piedras de los campos.
captionTranslations.pl: Jedni kopią ziemię i wynoszą kamienie z pól.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba ay humuhukay ng lupa at nagdadala ng mga bato mula sa mga bukid.

panels.scene: Different farmers in an orchard, reaching up with sickles or pulling fruit from branches into baskets.
panels.greekCaption: ἄλλοι δὲ θερίζουσιν τοὺς καρποὺς ἐκ τῶν δένδρων.
panels.englishCaption: Others harvest fruits from the trees.

captionTranslations.es: Otros cosechan frutas de los árboles.
captionTranslations.pl: Inni zbierają owoce z drzew.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba naman ay nag-aani ng mga bunga mula sa mga puno.

panels.scene: Three farmers sitting in the shade of a large tree, talking with animated gestures. A thought-bubble shows children playing.
panels.greekCaption: ἄλλοι καθίζουσιν ὑπὸ τοῖς δένδροις καὶ λαλοῦσιν περὶ τοῦ βίου καὶ περὶ τῶν τέκνων.
panels.englishCaption: Others sit under the trees and talk about life and about their children.

captionTranslations.es: Otros se sientan bajo los árboles y hablan de la vida y de sus hijos.
captionTranslations.pl: Inni siedzą pod drzewami i rozmawiają o życiu i o dzieciach.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba naman ay nakaupo sa ilalim ng mga puno at nag-uusap tungkol sa buhay at sa kanilang mga anak.

panels.scene: The dark, cool area under a broad tree canopy, dappled light. Farmers resting against the trunk. Blazing sun visible just beyond the shade.
panels.greekCaption: ἀναπαύονται ὑπὸ τοῖς δένδροις ἐν ταῖς σκιαῖς.
panels.englishCaption: They rest under the trees in the shade.

captionTranslations.es: Descansan bajo los árboles en la sombra.
captionTranslations.pl: Odpoczywają pod drzewami w cieniu.
captionTranslations.fil: Nagpapahinga sila sa ilalim ng mga puno sa lilim.

panels.scene: A panoramic view of the farming landscape: many fields visible, farmers working in each. The sun suggesting the daily cycle.
panels.greekCaption: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ βίος ἐν τοῖς ἀγροῖς — καθ᾽ ἡμέραν.
panels.englishCaption: This is life in the fields — every day.

captionTranslations.es: Esta es la vida en los campos — cada día.
captionTranslations.pl: To jest życie na polach — każdego dnia.
captionTranslations.fil: Ito ang buhay sa mga bukid — araw-araw.

panels.scene: A wealthy farmer surveying a large, prosperous field with many animals, while several workers labor behind him. Better-dressed than most.
panels.greekCaption: οἱ μέν εἰσιν πλούσιοι — ἔχουσιν ἀγροὺς μεγάλους καὶ πολλὰ ζῷα καὶ πολλοὺς δούλους.
panels.englishCaption: Some are rich — they have great fields, many animals, and many slaves.

captionTranslations.es: Algunos son ricos: tienen grandes campos, muchos animales y muchos esclavos.
captionTranslations.pl: Niektórzy są bogaci — mają wielkie pola, wiele zwierząt i wielu niewolników.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba ay mayaman — mayroon silang malalaking bukid, maraming hayop, at maraming alipin.

panels.scene: A poorer farmer working alone in a smaller field, simpler clothing, no help. Working with dignity.
panels.greekCaption: ἕτεροι δέ εἰσιν πτωχοί — ἐργάζονται ἐν τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀγροῖς μόνοι.
panels.englishCaption: Others are poor — they work in their own fields alone.

captionTranslations.es: Otros son pobres: trabajan en sus propios campos solos.
captionTranslations.pl: Inni są biedni — pracują na własnych polach sami.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang iba naman ay mahirap — nagtatrabaho sa kanilang sariling mga bukid nang mag-isa.

panels.scene: Side by side: the wealthy farmer with workers on one side, the poor farmer alone on the other — both sweating, both laboring under the same sun.
panels.greekCaption: ἀμφότεροι ἐργάζονται ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
panels.englishCaption: Both rich and poor work all day.

captionTranslations.es: Tanto ricos como pobres trabajan todo el día.
captionTranslations.pl: Zarówno bogaci, jak i biedni pracują przez cały dzień.
captionTranslations.fil: Kapwa ang mayaman at mahirap ay nagtatrabaho buong araw.

panels.scene: Paired emotion: tired farmers leaning on tools (weariness) beside the same farmers holding baskets of ripe fruit and smiling (joy).
panels.greekCaption: κοπιῶσιν διὰ τὸ ἔργον — ἀλλὰ χαίρουσιν διὰ τὸν καρπὸν τοῦ ἔργου.
panels.englishCaption: They grow weary because of the work — but rejoice because of the fruit of the work.

captionTranslations.es: Se cansan a causa del trabajo, pero se alegran a causa del fruto del trabajo.
captionTranslations.pl: Trudzą się z powodu pracy, ale radują się z powodu owocu pracy.
captionTranslations.fil: Napapagod sila dahil sa trabaho — ngunit nagagalak dahil sa bunga ng trabaho.

panels.scene: Rich brown soil with green shoots emerging, ripe fruit growing from plants. An image of agricultural abundance coming from the earth itself.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ γῆ παρέχει τοὺς καρποὺς τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν.
panels.englishCaption: The earth provides the fruits of their works.

captionTranslations.es: La tierra provee los frutos de sus trabajos.
captionTranslations.pl: Ziemia dostarcza owoców ich prac.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang lupa ay nagbibigay ng mga bunga ng kanilang mga gawa.

panels.scene: An elevated view: the road cutting through farmland on both sides, trees lining the edges.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ ὁδὸς πορεύεται διὰ τῶν ἀγρῶν — ἀγροὶ περὶ τὴν ὁδόν.
panels.englishCaption: The road goes through the fields — fields around the road.

captionTranslations.es: El camino pasa por los campos — campos alrededor del camino.
captionTranslations.pl: Droga przechodzi przez pola — pola wokół drogi.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang daan ay dumadaan sa mga bukid — mga bukid sa paligid ng daan.

panels.scene: The sun directly overhead at midday, blazing white-hot. Heat shimmer visible on the road below. Everything parched and bright.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ἥλιος ἐν τῷ μέσῳ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καυματίζει. μέγα καῦμά ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The sun in the middle of the sky scorches — great heat.

captionTranslations.es: El sol en medio del cielo abrasa — gran calor.
captionTranslations.pl: Słońce w środku nieba pali — wielki skwar.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang araw sa gitna ng langit ay nagsusunog — matinding init.

panels.scene: Jacob wiping sweat from his brow, one hand on his stomach (hunger), dry lips (thirst). The donkey also looking fatigued.
panels.greekCaption: κοπιᾷ ὁ Ἰάκωβος ἐν τῷ σώματι. πεινᾷ καὶ διψᾷ.
panels.englishCaption: Jacob grows weary in his body — hungry and thirsty.

captionTranslations.es: Jacob se cansa en su cuerpo. Tiene hambre y sed.
captionTranslations.pl: Jakub jest zmęczony w ciele. Jest głodny i spragniony.
captionTranslations.fil: Napapagod si Jacob sa kanyang katawan. Nagugutom at nauuhaw siya.

panels.scene: Jacob shading his eyes with his hand, scanning the landscape, searching for a place to rest.
panels.greekCaption: ζητεῖ τόπον ὅπου δύναται καθίζειν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθαι.
panels.englishCaption: He seeks a place where he can sit and rest.

captionTranslations.es: Busca un lugar donde pueda sentarse y descansar.
captionTranslations.pl: Szuka miejsca, gdzie może usiąść i odpocząć.
captionTranslations.fil: Naghahanap siya ng lugar kung saan maaari siyang umupo at magpahinga.

panels.scene: The large tree appears ahead beside the road, its broad canopy casting cool shade. Beneath it, a stone-rimmed spring is visible — a welcoming sight.
panels.greekCaption: εὑρίσκει δένδρον μέγα ἐγγὺς τῆς ὁδοῦ — καὶ πηγὴν ὑπὸ τῷ δένδρῳ.
panels.englishCaption: He finds the great tree near the road — and a spring under it.

captionTranslations.es: Encuentra el gran árbol cerca del camino — y un manantial bajo él.
captionTranslations.pl: Znajduje wielkie drzewo blisko drogi — i źródło pod nim.
captionTranslations.fil: Nahanap niya ang malaking puno malapit sa daan — at isang bukal sa ilalim nito.

panels.scene: Close-up of the spring: clear, sparkling water in a natural stone basin. Pebbles visible at the bottom. Light reflecting on the surface.
panels.greekCaption: ἐν τῇ πηγῇ ἐστιν ὕδωρ ἀγαθὸν καὶ καθαρόν.
panels.englishCaption: In the spring there is good and clean water.

captionTranslations.es: En el manantial hay agua buena y limpia.
captionTranslations.pl: W źródle jest dobra i czysta woda.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa bukal ay may mabuti at malinis na tubig.

panels.scene: Under the tree: the shade dappled across the ground, the spring beside it. A traveler resting there — relief and refreshment.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ δένδρον παρέχει σκιάν. οἱ κοπιῶντες ἀναπαύονται καὶ πίνουσιν ἐκεῖ.
panels.englishCaption: The tree provides shade. The weary rest and drink there.

captionTranslations.es: El árbol da sombra. Los cansados descansan y beben allí.
captionTranslations.pl: Drzewo daje cień. Zmęczeni odpoczywają i piją tam.
captionTranslations.fil: Ang puno ay nagbibigay ng lilim. Ang mga pagod ay nagpapahinga at umiinom doon.

panels.scene: Jacob seated under the tree, bag open beside him, breaking bread. The donkey resting nearby. Relief on his face.
panels.greekCaption: καθίζει καὶ ἀναπαύεται ὑπὸ τῷ δένδρῳ. εἶτα ἀνοίγει τὴν πήραν καὶ ἐσθίει.
panels.englishCaption: He sits and rests under the tree. Then he opens his bag and eats.

captionTranslations.es: Se sienta y descansa bajo el árbol. Luego abre su bolsa y come.
captionTranslations.pl: Siada i odpoczywa pod drzewem. Potem otwiera torbę i je.
captionTranslations.fil: Umupo siya at nagpahinga sa ilalim ng puno. Pagkatapos binuksan niya ang bag at kumain.

panels.scene: Jacob looking at the spring, hands empty, no container. The water is right there but he cannot draw it out.
panels.greekCaption: διψᾷ ἀλλὰ οὐκ ἔχει ὑδρίαν. οὐ δύναται ἀντλεῖν τὸ ὕδωρ.
panels.englishCaption: He is thirsty but has no water jar. He cannot draw the water.

captionTranslations.es: Tiene sed pero no tiene cántaro. No puede sacar el agua.
captionTranslations.pl: Jest spragniony, ale nie ma dzbana. Nie może czerpać wody.
captionTranslations.fil: Nauuhaw siya ngunit wala siyang tapayan. Hindi niya makuha ang tubig.

subtitleTranslations.es: Unidad 2, Capítulo 4 — El Amigo y los Agricultores
